packageRules.description: Major updates only: group into one PR, run CI Check, automerge on green
Skip typescript major (TS7 native compiler restructures deps and breaks npm lockfile sync); upgrade manually if ever needed
book convention plugin from GitHub Packages
Skip patch/minor/digest/pin entirely: no PR, no CI (major-only policy, saves Actions minutes). Placed last so it overrides package-specific re-enables above.

Hugo is exempt from the major-only policy: it never leaves 0.x, so EVERY release is a minor and the rule above would silence it forever. Placed after that rule so this re-enable wins. Safe to automerge because the version now lives in exactly one place — the hugo-version default below. The runner image deliberately does not bake Hugo (see gh-runner/Dockerfile.runner); actions-hugo installs it per job, so there is nothing to keep in sync and the 'Verify Hugo version' guard cannot drift.
